## PMM: model

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
![](../excalidraw/PMM-103-PMM-with-latent.excalidraw.svg){width="100%"}
:::

::: {.column width="30%"}
<div style="font-size: 0.42em; line-height: 1.2;">
`cg` the cognitive class (Normal, MCI, Dementia). When developing and calibrating the model, it is fixed to the Manly-Jones class.

`f` a general cognitive factor measured by the 8 core cognitive tests. Thresholds are equal across classes. Self-rated memory has class-specific thresholds.

`K` holds the fixed coefficients from the robust norms group. Sociodemographic terms do not predict class.

Two models: a cognition model for the `r format(analysis2_pmm_n[["cognition"]], big.mark = ",")` participants with a test score or a self-rating of memory, and an informant model (Jorm IQCODE only) for the `r format(analysis2_pmm_n[["informant"]], big.mark = ",")` without them.

</div>
:::
